purpose: Teach: アルク/ホース/ボディー/マリン/キッド/チャーリー/アドバンス/ブランチ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが英語教材アルクのテープを蔵書された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected those English learning tapes from Alc.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle pace, as if reaching back through years. Tender reverence for the memory. Voice settles on the detail.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、庭のホース、つまり水撒きホースを工夫されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Mm, and Grandpa, when you were young, you were so clever with that garden hose, weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, affirming tone with a gentle tease. She's turning the memory back to him—playful but genuinely pleased. Light knowing laughter underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが車のボディー磨きを毎週されてた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to polish the car body every single week.
lines.style: Same soft nostalgia as before. Quiet admiration in the voice. Slight pause before 'every week'—letting the dedication land.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、夫婦でマリンスポーツを楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you and your wife used to enjoy water sports together, didn't you?
lines.style: Playful reminder. A knowing glance in the voice. She's reclaiming the conversation—gently insisting he remember his own story. Warm and slightly amused.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが映画「キッド」を観られた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he saw the film 'Kid.'
lines.style: Same wistful, reaching quality. Almost musing. Voice rests gently on the film title—a small, precious detail from decades ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、チャップリンのチャーリーをお好みだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you loved Chaplin's Charlie films, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm affirmation. She knows this about him. A small smile in her voice—she's been listening all along. Closing the pattern gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがゲームのアドバンス機を私に下さった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he gave me a Game Boy Advance.
lines.style: Same soft nostalgia, but with a subtle shift—this gift mattered. Voice brightens just slightly on the memory. Lingering quality, like he can still feel it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、日曜のブランチがお好きだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, when you were young, you did love Sunday brunch, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm closing tone. She knows this one too. Her voice settles into contentment—the final answer in their quiet duet. Gentle, intimate fadeout.
